using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.server;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class SingleDatabaseManagerTests
    {
        // Helper to create a SingleDatabaseManager with minimal dependencies
        private SingleDatabaseManager CreateManager()
        {
            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(null, null);
            storeWrapperMock.SetupGet(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(new LoggerFactory());
            var createDbDelegate = new StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate(id => new GarnetDatabase(id));
            return new SingleDatabaseManager(createDbDelegate, storeWrapperMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsInformationWhenAofSizeExceedsLimit()
        {
            // Arrange
            var manager = CreateManager();

            // Setup AppendOnlyFile to simulate AOF size exceeding limit
            var aofSizeLimit = 10L;

            // We need to simulate AppendOnlyFile.TailAddress and BeginAddress
            // Since AppendOnlyFile is not accessible, we simulate by subclassing and overriding TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync
            // But since we cannot override, we test with a logger and a fake that triggers the log

            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();

            // We will call the method with aofSizeLimit smaller than the difference TailAddress - BeginAddress
            // But we don't have access to AppendOnlyFile, so we cannot set TailAddress or BeginAddress.
            // So we expect the method to return early if aofSize <= aofSizeLimit.
            // To force the log, we can call with aofSizeLimit = 0 to ensure aofSize > aofSizeLimit.

            // Act
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(0, logger: loggerMock.Object);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Enforcing AOF size limit")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

                }
